content: रुज् I. €6 <ab>P.</ab> (रुजति, रुग्ण) .²1 To break to pieces, destroy; वायुरुग्णान् <ls>R. 9. 63</ls>; शैलरुग्णमतङ्गजः <ls n="R.">12. 73</ls>; <ls>Bk. 4. 42</ls>. .²2 To pain, injure, disorder, afflict with disease, (sometimes with <ab>gen.</ab>); रावणस्येह रोक्ष्यन्ति कपयो भीमविक्रमाः <ls>Bk. 8. 120</ls>. .²3 To bend. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (रोजयति-ते) To hurt, kill.
